description: Add a durable, project-scoped inbox: server-side projection over the four MVP events into an InboxItem read model (idempotent by CloudEvent id, strict project isolation), a project inbox HTTP API (list / mark-one-read / mark-all-read / archive), and a Web UI project inbox page with empty state, read/unread presentation, deep-links, and invalidation-only live refresh.

tasks.title: Inbox read model: InboxItemRow, indexes, and EF migration
tasks.description: Add the InboxItemRow entity to MohistDbContext with the columns from design D2 (Id, ProjectId, IssueId, IssueNumber, IssueTitle, NotificationKind, SourceEventId, CreatedAt, ReadAt, ArchivedAt). Add the (ProjectId, CreatedAt DESC) list index, the UNIQUE(SourceEventId) idempotency index, and a (ProjectId, Id) lookup index. Add a manual EF migration consistent with the existing 73 migrations. Register the new DbSet on MohistDbContext.
acceptanceCriteria: MohistDbContext exposes an InboxItems DbSet with the required columns and types.
A new migration creates the InboxItems table with IX_InboxItems_ProjectId_CreatedAt, UQ_InboxItems_SourceEventId, and IX_InboxItems_ProjectId_Id indexes.
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) passes.
The migration is schema-only additive (no data backfill) and its Down drops the table.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Infrastructure/Data/Inbox/InboxItemRow.cs, MohistDbContext changes, new migration under Infrastructure/Data/Migrations/
tasks.notes: Follow design.md D2. Columns/types mirror EpicRow for ProjectId (TEXT), string Ids, DateTimeOffset timestamps. NotificationKind stored as a TEXT enum string.

tasks.title: InboxStore + InboxQuerier (writes, reads, idempotency, project isolation)
tasks.description: Add InboxStore (writes one item per source event using the UNIQUE(SourceEventId) conflict-skip for idempotency; mark-one-read, mark-all-read-by-project, archive-by-item-and-project) and InboxQuerier (list-most-recent-first excluding archived, scoped by projectId). Both live in a new packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Inbox/ module following the *Store/*Querier role names. Mark-all-read and archive must filter WHERE ProjectId = @pid; mutations against an item whose ProjectId differs from the resolved project must affect zero rows (callers translate to 404).
acceptanceCriteria: InboxQuerier.ListAsync(projectId) returns non-archived items ordered most-recent-first by CreatedAt.
InboxStore insert is idempotent: re-inserting the same SourceEventId does not throw and does not create a duplicate row.
MarkAllReadAsync(projectId) only updates non-archived rows in that project.
Archive/MarkRead by itemId honor ProjectId; an item in another project yields zero affected rows.
Unit/integration specs cover list ordering, idempotency under repeat insert, and project isolation (project A cannot see/mutate project B items).
tasks.notes: Use IDbContextFactory<MohistDbContext> like IssueStore/EpicQuerier. Idempotency relies on the UNIQUE index from T-001; catch the unique-constraint exception (or use the SQLite/EF conflict handling) to treat a duplicate SourceEventId as already-projected.

tasks.title: Inbox projection: CloudEvents bus handler for the four MVP events
tasks.description: Add an ICloudEventHandler in packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Events/Subscriptions/ (same pattern as EpicAutoDoneHandler/WorkflowStageLockReleaseHandler) subscribed to com.mohist.workflow.run.failed|com.mohist.workflow.stage.approval-requested|com.mohist.issue.work-started|com.mohist.issue.work-completed. For issue events read projectid/issueid/issueno from evt.Extensions and load the issue via IssueStore only to snapshot the title. For workflow events extract workflowRunId from the /mohist/workflow-runs/{id} source URI (reuse ExtractWorkflowRunId), load the run via WorkflowRunStore.LoadAsync to read Metadata.Annotations projectId/issueId/issueNumber, then load the issue title. Map each type to its NotificationKind, write one InboxItemRow via InboxStore with SourceEventId = evt.Id. Log and skip on missing identity (same defensive pattern as EpicReconcileDispatcher). Runs inline on the bus; exceptions are logged, never propagated.
acceptanceCriteria: One WorkflowRunFailed event produces exactly one workflow_failed item in the owning project.
One StageApprovalRequested event produces exactly one approval_requested item in the owning project.
One IssueWorkStarted event produces exactly one issue_started item in the owning project.
One IssueWorkCompleted event produces exactly one issue_completed item in the owning project.
Replaying the same CloudEvent (same evt.Id) does not create a second item (idempotency via SourceEventId).
Items land only in the owning project; an event without projectid/issueId annotations is logged and skipped without throwing.
Auto-registered via the existing AddCloudEventHandlersFromAssembly scan (no manual DI registration needed).
Specs cover all four kinds, idempotency under replay, project isolation, and the missing-identity skip path.
tasks.notes: Per design D1, D4, D5. Use WorkflowRunStore.LoadAsync (not IWorkflowGrain) to avoid re-entering the workflow grain from the publish call stack. Match EventCatalog type strings exactly. NotificationKind snapshot of IssueTitle is captured once at projection time (design D6); the Web client renders the product-facing text (design D7).

tasks.title: Project inbox HTTP API routes (list / mark-one-read / mark-all-read / archive)
tasks.description: Add InboxRoutes.MapInboxRoutes extending WebApplication, mounting MapGroup("/api/projects/{projectRef}/inbox").AddEndpointFilter<ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter>(). Routes: GET / (list via InboxQuerier), POST /{itemId}/read (mark one read), POST /read-all (mark all project items read), POST /{itemId}/archive (archive/dismiss one). Resolve projectRef via context.GetResolvedProject().Id. Mutations that affect zero rows (cross-project itemId) return 404. Register the routes in MohistApiRegistration.MapMohistApi alongside the other Map*Routes calls. Define the response DTO (itemId, notificationKind, issueNumber, issueTitle, createdAt, readAt/isRead, archivedAt) — text is NOT stored, only structured fields.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/inbox returns items with notificationKind, issueNumber, issueTitle, createdAt, read/unread state, most-recent-first, excluding archived.
POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/inbox/{itemId}/read sets that item read and leaves others unchanged.
POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/inbox/read-all marks all non-archived items in the resolved project read.
POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/inbox/{itemId}/archive excludes the item from the default list thereafter.
Any operation scoped to project A against an item belonging to project B is rejected as 404.
MapInboxRoutes is wired into MohistApiRegistration.
Integration specs (ApiTestClient pattern) cover list ordering/fields, each mutation, and the cross-project 404 path.
tasks.notes: Mirror EpicRoutes for the group/filter/GetResolvedProject pattern. T-003 (projection) is not strictly required for the routes to compile, but end-to-end specs will want items present; list/mutation specs can seed rows directly via the store. Depends on T-002 only for the store/querier contract.

tasks.title: Web inbox entity, page, route, and invalidation-only live refresh
tasks.description: Add packages/web/src/entities/inbox/ (client.ts typed fetch helpers via request/projectApiPath; queries.ts with useInbox plus useMarkInboxItemRead/useMarkAllInboxRead/useArchiveInboxItem mutations; model/types.ts with InboxItem and NotificationKind). Add packages/web/src/pages/inbox/InboxPage.tsx: list rendering notificationKind + issue number + title + relative time, distinct unread vs read presentation, deep-link from each item to /:projectName/issues/:number via useProjectPath, and an explicit empty state for projects with no items. Add the /:projectName/inbox Route under ProjectRouteScope in App.tsx. Subscribe to the existing EventBridge for the four com.mohist.* event types and on any of them invalidate the TanStack inbox query — never synthesize items locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /:projectName/inbox renders InboxPage and integrates with the existing project route scope.
The page lists inbox items with kind, issue number, issue title, creation time, and read/unread styling, and each item links to the issue detail route.
The page renders an explicit empty state when the project has no inbox items.
Product-facing text is rendered on the client from kind -> template (e.g. 'Issue #42 needs approval'), not from a stored text field.
Mark-read / mark-all-read / archive mutations call the inbox API and refresh the list via query invalidation.
On receiving any of the four com.mohist.* events over the live connection, the page invalidates the inbox query only — it does not synthesize or persist items.
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass; new queries/hooks have unit tests mirroring entities/epic/api/queries.test.ts.
tasks.notes: Mirror entities/epic structure. Invalidation-only keeps the durable API as the single source of truth (design D9). Reuse useProjectPath/useProjectName helpers for deep-links.
